title: polybotrya aurita
intro: Polybotrya aurita, commonly known as the polybotrya or crown fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Polybotrya aurita include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
